bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
prior="$root/.releases/807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf/video-production-compat"
target="$root/.releases/807cea978e88b04cffbc27eb4497183671ac79cf/video-old-runtime-test-baseline"
image=create-videobot:video-old-runtime-tests-807cea97
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 63
test -s "$prior/test-results.log" && test -s "$prior/test/creatorWizard.test.mjs" && test -s "$prior/test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs" || exit 64
test ! -e "$target" && test -z "$(docker images -q "$image")" || exit 65
mkdir -p "$target/test"
for p in creatorWizard.test.mjs creatorUi.test.mjs creatorBot.test.mjs creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs paidListingPublisher.test.mjs;do cp "$prior/test/$p" "$target/test/$p";done
{ echo 'FROM create-videobot:local-poll';echo 'USER root';for p in creatorWizard.test.mjs creatorUi.test.mjs creatorBot.test.mjs creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs paidListingPublisher.test.mjs;do echo "COPY --chown=node:node test/$p /opt/videobot/test/$p";done;echo 'USER node';} > "$target/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$image" "$target" >/dev/null || exit 66
docker run --rm --network none -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$image" --test test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs > "$target/test-results.log" 2>&1 || true
export VIDEO_PRIOR="$prior" VIDEO_BASELINE="$target"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
a=Path(os.environ['VIDEO_PRIOR'])/'test-results.log'
b=Path(os.environ['VIDEO_BASELINE'])/'test-results.log'
def failset(p):
 s=p.read_text(errors='replace')
 return {x.strip() for x in re.findall(r'(?m)^not ok \d+ - ([^\n]+)',s)}
cand=failset(a);base=failset(b)
if not cand or not base:sys.exit(70)
introduced=cand-base
newtests=[
'initial video upload asks for optional description after private preview and accepts direct text',
'skip on optional description keeps the real album and reaches the ordinary editor once',
'buyer can read no-voluntary-refund notice before the official Stars unlock']
if any(t in cand for t in newtests):sys.exit(71)
if not any(t in base for t in newtests):sys.exit(72)
if introduced:
 print('VIDEO_NEW_REGRESSION_TESTS_PRESENT=YES')
 sys.exit(90+min(30,len(introduced)))
print('VIDEO_SOURCE_TEST_FAILURES_NO_WORSE_THAN_LIVE_BASELINE=PASS')
print('VIDEO_NEW_DESCRIPTION_SKIP_BUYER_NOTICE_TESTS=PASS')
PY
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 74
test "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" || exit 75
echo VIDEO_BASELINE_COMPARISON_NO_LIVE_MUTATION=PASS
